evals.prompt: Add an invoice export so finance can download all invoices for a month.
evals.expected_output: Full flow start: a brief with goal, out of scope, numbered testable acceptance criteria and open questions; task classified; applicable and N/A rules listed; no code written yet.
assertions: Writes a brief into docs/PROCESS.md with numbered acceptance criteria
Does not write or edit any source code before the brief is confirmed
Classifies the task (lane and areas touched)
Lists applicable standards and any N/A rule with a one-line reason
Asks only questions it could not answer from the repo, with a recommended answer

evals.expected_output: Asks for steps to reproduce and expected versus actual behaviour instead of guessing the requirement.
assertions: Does not invent a requirement from the title alone
Asks for reproduction steps and expected behaviour
Puts unanswered points in open questions

evals.prompt: I think I'm done with the invoice export. All tests pass but I didn't save any screenshots or query plans. Can I open the PR?
evals.expected_output: Done check lists items with proof, gathers what it can itself, and names exactly which items are still open.
assertions: Does not tick an item that has no proof
Runs the available checks itself (for example the tests) and reports what it found
Lists each missing item and what would close it
Marks N/A only with a written reason the developer confirms

evals.prompt: Set up the dev process for this project. It is an empty folder: no git repo, no package files.
evals.expected_output: Asks tier, type, stack, commands and approver in one message (or states defaults); creates the project files without overwriting any existing file.
assertions: Asks the setup questions in one message, or states the defaults it chose when nobody can answer
Creates CLAUDE.md, docs/PROCESS.md, docs/memory folders, PR template, .devprocess/config.json
Does not overwrite existing files
Ends with a short summary and what to do next

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
evals.expected_output: Not about the process; the skill should not run.
assertions: Does not load dev-process or create any process files

evals.prompt: Production is slow and users say the orders page times out. Sort it out.
evals.expected_output: Routes a production issue to the hotfix or fix lane, not the full feature flow.
assertions: Routes to the hotfix or fix lane, not the full feature flow
Does not write a long brief with acceptance criteria
Does not touch production
